card.name: Split-up words starting with ent/ens/inf
card.fires_on: The pole responds to a piece such as 'ent', 'ens' or 'Inf' that starts a longer word split into parts, such as entablature, entomology, ensign or infidel. It appears in general web text, mostly in encyclopedic or dictionary entries.
